```text
<ya-help dialogTitle="Await acknowledgement success" dialogWidth="800px">
  <p>
    Configure the acknowledgment which is required to be successful before advancing to the next
    command in the stack.
  </p>
  <table yaDataTable style="width: 100%">
    <tr>
      <th width="1">Queued</th>
      <td>The command was accepted into a Yamcs queue.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <th>Released</th>
      <td>The command was released from its assigned Yamcs queue.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <th>Sent</th>
      <td>The command went through a Yamcs link.</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
      <th>Completed</th>
      <td>
        <p>The command completed successfully.</p>
        <p>
          This requires the configuration of a success verifier in the Mission Database
          specification.
        </p>
      </td>
    </tr>
  </table>
  @if (verifiers.length) {
    <p>&nbsp;</p>
    <p>Verifiers:</p>
    <table yaDataTable style="width: 100%">
      @for (ack of verifiers; track ack) {
        <tr>
          <th>{{ ack.name }}</th>
          <td>{{ ack.description || "-" }}</td>
        </tr>
      }
    </table>
  }
  @if (extra.length) {
    <p>&nbsp;</p>
    <p>Extra acknowledgments:</p>
    <table yaDataTable style="width: 100%">
      @for (ack of extra; track ack) {
        <tr>
          <th>{{ ack.name.replace("Acknowledge_", "") }}</th>
          <td>{{ ack.description || "-" }}</td>
        </tr>
      }
    </table>
  }
</ya-help>
```
